title: Plugin Manifest v1
description: Plugin Subsystem v1 manifest vocabulary (MANIFEST.yaml). FROZEN surface per .agents/shared/planning/plugin-subsystem/v1-interface-contracts.md §2. Unknown fields are refused by construction (additionalProperties: false at every level). Additive evolution is 1.0.x only (see ¨8 versioning rule in CONVENTION.md).

schema_version.description: SemVer. Plugin #1 authors against the literal "1.0.0". 1.0.x = additive only; the validator accepts the 1.0.x family and refuses anything else until the runner carries the newer schema.

name.description: kebab-case; MUST match the plugin directory name (semantic check in manifest_reader).

license.description: SPDX id; validated exact-match against plugins-convention/spdx_ids.json (validator list is EVOLVABLE; the field carry is FROZEN).

tag_pin_per_class.description: TAG-ONLY pins per provenance class (bare SHAs and empty values refused). snapshot_with_drift_alarm absent => inherit copy_freely pin. own_outright is never synced, so it carries no pin.

integration_path.description: "A" only with a complete fence_grant block (semantic check).

execution_mode.description: POSITIVE declaration; absent => REFUSE (silence is not permission). Enforced semantically with refusal code absent_execution_mode, hence not listed in the schema-level required set.

entrypoint.description: B-path field; relative path rooted under adapter/ (semantic check). <=200-line tripwire numeric CI lands with the first real plugin trees (slice 2).

runtime_pin.description: Exact version pin; ranges refused (semantic check, strict peer-dep).

ipc_schema_pin.description: Semver pin of the IPC schema.

fence_grant.description: FROZEN block; required iff integration_path=A (semantic refusal fence_missing).

copy_freely.description: Clean-pulled upstream data; never authored locally. alarm_owner REQUIRED (empty => refused manifest).

paths.description: Globs relative to the plugin tree root.

alarm_owner.description: Role-or-team that owns this class's drift alarms.

escalation.description: EVOLVABLE placeholder; v1 default semantics: block-promote-after-days with N=14.

snapshot_with_drift_alarm.description: Hot upstream content snapshotted with drift alarms + reconcile. Non-empty paths REQUIRE a non-empty divergence_register (empty register on non-empty path = refused).

items.description: Numbered, exhaustive. upstream_ref is the one optional field per the CON §2 vocabulary.

own_outright.description: Ensemble-authored, never synced, invisible to the sync-runner. Deliberately carries NO alarm_owner (authored locally — there is nothing upstream to alarm on) and NO divergence_register; declaring either here is a vocabulary refusal by construction.

parity_boundary.description: REQUIRED SECTION (semantic check missing_parity_boundary). Subsections are lists that may be empty; any row present must carry exactly {path, reason}.
